Dear TUI Hiring Team,

I'm applying for the Digital Analyst role. With a technical background in computer science and hands-on experience turning data into actionable insights, I'm excited by the opportunity to help TUI become the leader in travel technology.

In my current roles, I use Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs daily to track performance, identify trends and report on organic growth for client websites. I've built and optimized sites in WordPress and Shopify, implemented structured data and run technical audits that measurably improved search health. My front-end development experience (AngularJS, JavaScript) gives me a solid foundation for working with data query languages and understanding web analytics implementation.

I'm fluent in English, native in Turkish, and have working knowledge of Dutch. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how my analytical skills and collaborative approach can support TUI's data-driven decision making.

Kind regards,

cover_letter:
Dear TUI Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Digital Analyst position at TUI. With a technical foundation in computer science and practical experience in digital analytics and reporting, I am drawn to TUI's ambition to lead in travel technology and would be excited to contribute to that journey.

In my current roles as a freelance SEO specialist and junior digital marketer, I work with Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs to collect, clean and analyse data from multiple sources. I create regular reports and dashboards that communicate key metrics clearly to stakeholders, and I respond to ad-hoc analysis requests by clarifying requirements and delivering timely insights. For example, I built and optimized a multi-page website for a Belgian youth chess champion, implementing structured data and running iterative technical audits that measurably raised the site's search-health score. I also have front-end development experience in AngularJS and JavaScript, which gives me a solid understanding of web analytics implementation and data querying.

My data storytelling skills allow me to explain complex findings to both technical and non-technical audiences. I am detail-oriented and committed to data accuracy, and I enjoy collaborating with team members to translate business questions into analytical approaches. I am fluent in English, native in Turkish, and have working knowledge of Dutch.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my analytical skills and collaborative approach can support TUI's data-driven decision making and enhance the customer experience.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
baverok.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok
